title: Notched lapel collar, single breasted, medium lapel

doc.break: height of the break point (where the lapel starts to roll, at the top button) below the neck point level
doc.stand: the roll line starts this far past the neck point on the extended shoulder line (collar stand at the shoulder)
doc.lapel: lapel width, square to the roll line, from the roll line to the lapel point
doc.belly: bow of the lapel's outer edge at its middle
doc.gorge_y: height, below the neck point level, where the gorge line leaves the new neckline
doc.gorge_angle: angle between the gorge line and the roll line, degrees
doc.notch_lapel: length of the lapel side of the notch
doc.notch_collar: length of the collar side of the notch
doc.collar_stand: collar stand at the centre back
doc.collar_fall: collar fall at the centre back
doc.spring: how far the collar's neck edge swings off the roll line over the back neck length
doc.turn_of_cloth: top collar larger than the undercollar by this, outer edge and end
doc.facing_turn: lapel facing larger than the front at the lapel edge by this

provenance.rights: Values compiled by the project, MIT like the code
provenance.notes: Values inside the ranges of the technique sheet; the outline they give was not compared to a published draft.
